title: Rule to Allow Crypto in 401(k)s Arrives at White House for Final Review
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Rule to Allow Crypto in 401(k)s Arrives at White House for Final Review

A final Labor Department rule that would create a fiduciary safe harbor for private equity, real estate and crypto in 401(k) menus arrived at OIRA on Thursday, putting public release within reach.

This post Rule to Allow Crypto in 401(k)s Arrives at White House for Final Review first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says

About 42 million stolen XRP, worth roughly $50 million, has been swapped mostly into bitcoin via THORChain, Elliptic said, lifting converted bitcoin from the Binance theft to about 1,650 BTC.

This post Binance Hackers Swap About $50 Million of Stolen XRP Mostly Into Bitcoin, Elliptic Says first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Bitcoin Price Holds Near $75,000 After Hot October Jobs Report
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Bitcoin Price Holds Near $75,000 After Hot October Jobs Report

Bitcoin price held near $75,800 Friday after U.S. employers added 165,000 jobs in October, far above the 59,000 forecast, as December Fed hike odds climbed toward 80%.

This post Bitcoin Price Holds Near $75,000 After Hot October Jobs Report first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: South Korean Crypto Exchange Gopax Suspends Withdrawals and Trading After Hacking Threat
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

South Korean Crypto Exchange Gopax Suspends Withdrawals and Trading After Hacking Threat

South Korea's Gopax halted standard withdrawals at 2:55 p.m. and trading at 3:53 p.m. Friday after a hacking-threat email, and is transferring all held assets to cold wallets with no loss reported so far.

This post South Korean Crypto Exchange Gopax Suspends Withdrawals and Trading After Hacking Threat first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Bitcoin Price Trades Near $76,000 as Nasdaq Tumbles into Correction
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Bitcoin Price Trades Near $76,000 as Nasdaq Tumbles into Correction

Bitcoin price held near $76,000 Thursday afternoon as the Nasdaq sank deeper into a correction, crypto liquidations topped $1 billion and Strategy, Coinbase and bitcoin miners sold off in double digits.

This post Bitcoin Price Trades Near $76,000 as Nasdaq Tumbles into Correction first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
